sloka: न खल्वयं नाभिभवेदुपेक्षितः पराक्रमो ह्यस्य रणे विवर्धते ।प्रमापणं त्वेव ममास्य रोचते न वर्धमानो ऽग्निरुपेक्षितुं क्षमः ।। ५.४७.२९।।।।
transliteration: na khalvayaṁ nābhibhavedupekṣitaḥ parākramo hyasya raṇe vivardhate ।pramāpaṇaṁ tveva mamāsya rocate na vardhamāno 'gnirupekṣituṁ kṣamaḥ ।। 5.47.29।।।।

translations.english: If I ignore him now, he would get the better of me (I have to consider his challenge seriously). His valour in the battle is growing. It is proper to subdue him now. A spreading fire cannot be neglected.
